errors.evidence: The pie chart is divided into six segments (ENTITYQUEST, HOTPOTQA, TRIVIAQA, POPQA, WEBQUESTIO, TREC), not five. The description itself lists all six data sources later.

errors.text_span: The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top right, with the largest segments appearing first.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged by size. While the first three slices clockwise from the top right are in descending order of size (26.0%, 24.2%, 21.6%), the next slice is the smallest (TREC, 1.9%), which breaks the stated pattern.
